tools.name: find_by_craft
tools.description: Find frames by specific cinematography craft attributes — lens character, shot size, visual style, setting, time of day, director, or year range. All optional; combine to narrow. Use this to refine a search precisely.

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find frames visually/semantically similar to a given frame id (from a prior result). Use this to pull more references like one the user shortlisted.

tools.description: One frame's image at a paid size, as a link valid for an hour: "full" = the original full-resolution file (5 credits), "large" = 1280px (2), "depth" = the precomputed depth map, ControlNet-ready (2). findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_commercial · Private data: search_frames, get_frame_details, get_frame_image, commercials_profile, similar_animation_frames · Public sink: get_commercial, similar_animation_frames · Destructive: commercials_stats, get_animation_sequence.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_commercial · Private data: search_frames, get_frame_details, get_frame_image, commercials_profile, similar_animation_frames · Public sink: get_commercial, similar_animation_frames · Destructive: commercials_stats, get_animation_sequence

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
